text:
harper: hey folks :wave: first week on eng-ml. i'm blocked on observability access - Okta SSO sends me back a 'not authorized' when opening Grafana and Datadog. who owns the entitlements for model/team dashboards?

dylan: welcome harper :tada: i'm on identity. paste your Okta email and i'll check group mappings. Quick Q: do you need viewer only or edit + ability to provision dashboard folders?

harper: harper.tan@redwood.com. viewer for now, might ask for edit later. specifically want to see 'serving-latency' and 'model-costs-by-region' dashboards.

identity-bot: identity-bot created ticket IDP-3711 for harper.tan@redwood.com: "SSO entitlement failure for Grafana/Datadog". Assigned: dylan.

dylan: thanks. common cause is missing Okta group mapping to the Datadog team (we use SCIM group sync). i'll check if your account is in okta group 'infra-observe' or 'ml-observe'.

maria: cc @dylan : for Sentry access we need security approval. Also, Grafana often uses folder ACLs - if the dashboards live in a restricted folder you'll need folder-level view.

harper: i am not in infra-observe or ml-observe.

dylan: okay i'll add you to ml-observe and trigger SCIM sync. infra-bot will post invites when the downstream services get the change. ETA is usually <2h but can be longer if SCIM queue is backed up.

ml-platform: ml-platform: scheduled SCIM sync for group 'ml-observe' -> Datadog/Grafana at 2026-03-23T14:10:00Z.

harper: thanks. one more thing: any docs on how dashboard code is stored? i want to propose a smaller-time-window default for 'serving-latency' to focus on recent regressions.

maria: dashboards live in infra/grafana/dashboards in the platform repo. we prefer PRs with exported JSON model + short rationale. For Datadog dashboards/monitors, create saved queries or dashboards and open a PR to infra/datadog/dashboards. If it's a minor view-only tweak you can request a Grafana per-user preference change but it won't change the canonical dashboard.

dylan: SCIM sync completed, you should receive a Grafana invite and Datadog membership shortly. If you still hit 403, try an incognito window to clear SSO state.

grafana-bot: grafana-bot sent invite to harper.tan@redwood.com (expires in 7 days). Folder acl for infra added: 'viewer' granted.

harper: invite arrived and accepted : can see most infra dashboards but 'model-costs-by-region' isn't visible in the folder list. search for slug returns nothing.

dylan: that may be a permissions scope on the folder or the dashboard exists under a different slug. Can you paste the name from the onboarding doc?

harper: doc lists it as infra/model-costs-by-region.

dylan: granted folder-level access for that specific folder. Also checked Datadog team membership - you're now on team 'ml-inference-observe' which inherits monitors and dashboards.

grafana-bot: grafana-bot: folder ACL updated for user harper.tan@redwood.com -> folder: infra.

harper: Datadog shows up now and i can view monitors. found the model-costs dashboard in Grafana after the folder change. all good! :thumbsup:

maria: quick reminder - if you want to be paged for a service, we'll need you added to the PagerDuty escalation policy. file a request in #people-ops-support with service name + justification. Also enable 2FA for Sentry before accepting invites.

security-bot: security-bot recorded Sentry request SENTRY-999 and queued security review. Expected approval 24h.

harper: appreciate the help everyone. final ask: can someone give me a 15m walkthrough of the key dashboards for model infra (latency, cost, KV-cache-hit-rate)? would be great to see which alerts we rely on.

dylan: happy to run a quick tour. i'll DM to schedule and share a checklist of common dashboards + alert rules. added a note to the new-hire checklist: expect identity group adds <2h if groups are correct, otherwise up to 24h if security approval or SCIM backfill required.

harper: perfect, thanks and excited to get started! :heart:
